decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin builds directly on existing analytics and plugin development expertise and tracks the current standard, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve it, making discontinuation unlikely.

Universal Analytics has been retired by Google, and the firm's absorptive capacity should recognize that this product no longer has commercial value despite related technical knowledge, so dropping is highly probable.
The retail system interface plugin leverages the firm's interface development and partner networks, allowing it to learn from early implementations and refine the product, so it is likely kept.
As a relaunch SEO support service, it extends the firm's established SEO and project capabilities and has a dedicated web presence, indicating high absorptive capacity and commitment.
SEO workshops build directly on the firm's existing SEO knowledge and can be improved through client feedback and cooperation, so they are likely retained.
